_comment: The shape of the profile JobRadar matches jobs against. Copy this to
profile.json, fill it in, and run scripts/seed_profile.py. profile.json is
gitignored - it carries a real name, a real email, and a career history,
and none of that belongs in a public repository.
Order matters. matching.profile_query_text builds the search vector from
headline, then target_titles, then skills, then summary, and truncates from
the end - so the least specific field is the one that gets cut.
resume_text is used last and only as filler. Resume prose ('collaborated
with stakeholders to deliver') sits close to every job description ever
written, which makes it noise in a similarity search rather than signal.
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Builds production data platforms and the systems on top of them.
resume_text: Paste the plain text of your resume here. It is embedded in chunks, so length is fine.
